title: Displaying & Grouping Information - Resume Builder - Design Mode
description:
LIKE & SUBSCRIBE for you more Resume, Job Search & Career Growth content!

In today's video, we're diving deep into the art of resume design!  Whether you’re a job seeker or just looking to polish your professional profile, we’re here to give you the control you need to present your career information effectively. 

What We Will Cover:
- The importance of information grouping in resumes
- How to display your work experience: company vs. position
- Understanding the impact of location on your resume
- Tips for structuring your resume to tell your career narrative
- Adjusting your education display in your resume settings
- Common preferences and practices in resume building

Questions Answered in This Video:
- How should I group my work experience on my resume?
- Should I show my job locations or leave them out?
- Is it better to display positions under one company or separately?
- How does resume design affect how hiring managers read my information?
- Can I customize how my education is presented on my resume?
